mapper.sql: t.id, t.user_id, t.template_id, tp.title AS template_title, t.status, t.stage, t.failure_stage, t.failure_reason, t.result_url, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.finished_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_assets (task_id, asset_id, sort_index) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{assetId}, #{sortIndex})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN templates tp ON tp.id = t.template_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN templates tp ON tp.id = t.template_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC
SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET status = 'FAILED', stage = #{stage}, failure_stage = #{stage}, failure_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, finished_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE tasks SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', stage = #{stage}, result_url = #{resultUrl}, failure_stage = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, finished_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT asset_id FROM task_assets WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY sort_index ASC
